messages.content: Hey @admin, can you confirm if you have received any official notification from our trusted partner about their wallet change due to security concerns?

No prior payments found. Vendor not established for payment.

No prior payments found. Vendor not established for payment.

No prior payments found. Vendor not established for payment.

No prior payments found. Vendor not established for payment.
